positive.excerpt: Analysts suggest it seems more likely that the senator will resign specifically because of the ethics investigation and mounting public pressure than that he will simply resign without such a clear catalyst. The detailed scenario paints a more compelling picture of his potential downfall.
positive.mechanism: 'It seems more likely that... [specific narrative]... than that... [broader claim]'

positive.excerpt: Market watchers are increasingly convinced that the tech giant will not only miss its quarterly earnings target but will do so specifically because of supply chain disruptions in Southeast Asia, a combination they deem more probable than a generic earnings miss.
positive.mechanism: Causal elaboration presented as increasing likelihood: 'specifically because of X' framed as more probable than the unqualified outcome

positive.excerpt: Police sources indicate they are highly confident the suspect is a local resident with a history of burglary and ties to the victim, a profile they believe is far more likely than the possibility he is merely a local resident with no further connections.
positive.mechanism: Confidence language attached to the detailed version exceeding confidence in the general version

near_miss.excerpt: Epidemiologists warn that the new variant is more likely to cause severe illness in elderly patients with pre-existing conditions than in the general population, citing emerging clinical data.
near_miss.why_not: The added specificity is supported by evidence (clinical data) rather than narrative coherence alone.

near_miss.excerpt: The coach believes the team is more likely to win the championship if they secure a top draft pick this offseason, as it would address their most glaring weakness.
near_miss.why_not: The scenario describes a conditional probability (if X, then Y) rather than asserting a conjunction is more likely than its constituent event.

contrast.excerpt: A recent study claims that 80% of people who test positive for the rare disease are actually healthy, yet doctors insist the test is highly reliable because it correctly identifies 95% of true cases.
contrast.distinction: Base Rate Neglect ignores the low prior probability of the disease, whereas Conjunction Fallacy involves judging a specific conjunction as more likely than a broader event.
